articles.title: No more Cybertrucks; Musk moves on from the angular metallic flop
articles.summary:
Elon’s Edsel is no more. Last night, Tesla CEO Elon Musk revealed on social media that his car company is ending its failed attempt to wrest control of the American pickup truck market. The Cybertruck will cease production in the middle of 2027, liberating that space in Tesla’s cavernous factory for other uses—more Cybercabs, most likely.
Musk first revealed the Cybertruck in late 2019, back when Tesla was still trading at a theoretically understandable price-to-earning ratio. The pickup’s unusual angular shape owed more to low-res video game models than any concessions to practicality. At the time, Musk made fanciful claims that the truck would use a stainless steel monocoque construction, telling his audience that “the body and bed don’t do anything useful” on a normal truck. While some race cars use carbon-fiber monocoques for strength and lightness, making a pickup truck with a stainless steel monocoque chassis would only make sense if someone had an awful lot of stainless steel lying around and needed something to do with it all.
The truck was supposed to go on sale for less than $40,000, and Tesla made its usual stratospheric sales predictions that (had they been accurate) the bare metal EVs would be as ubiquitous as the Model 3 and Y.

Yelp has adopted a hybrid user interface architecture for its AI Assistant, combining native mobile controls with server-driven conversation rendering to support faster interface changes across platforms. The design uses Yelp’s CHAOS framework, short for Content Hosting Architecture with Optimization Strategies, to render conversation content while keeping navigation and message input native.
Yelp Assistant launched on iOS in 2024 to help users create project requests for local service professionals. It has since expanded to answer questions about businesses and support actions such as reservations, appointments, and food orders.
CHAOS supports web, iOS, and Android. In a server-driven UI architecture, the backend defines what the client displays and how it responds to interactions, so interface changes can reach users without requiring a new mobile app release.
Daniel Andrade Groppe, Services Tech Lead at Yelp, highlighted,
Our existing CHAOS framework lacked some of the capabilities the Assistant required, including text input fields and network requests. Fox has completed its $22 billion acquisition of Roku, wrapping up one of the biggest media deals in recent years and giving the company a major boost in the streaming and connected TV space.
Announced Friday, the deal brings the streaming company founded in 2002 formally under Fox’s ownership. Fox says the combined company now ranks as the third-largest television business in the U.S. by viewership.
“We started Roku more than two decades ago to give people a better way to watch TV, and that mission doesn’t change today. What does change is our reach and resources,” Roku founder Anthony Wood said in a statement. “Our teams will keep building and innovating as they always have, now with the support and capabilities of Fox behind us.”
For Fox, the move provides direct access to Roku’s reach of more than 100 million households. The company expects that audience to help it improve advertising targeting, strengthen its position in the fast-growing connected TV market, and reduce its reliance on traditional TV distribution.
Today’s announcement comes two months after the Justice Department issued a second request for information, asking both companies to provide additional data and documents as part of its antitrust review. Earlier this month, reports suggested the deal was nearing U.S. regulatory approval.
The acquisition also closed much earlier than expected. When the deal was first announced in June, the companies projected it would be completed in the first half of 2027.

Como explican en Ideal Home, la eficiencia depende del modelo, la temperatura exterior y el aislamiento de la vivienda. A diferencia de una estufa eléctrica convencional, los aparatos reversibles funcionan gracias a una bomba de calor que aprovecha la energía del aire exterior para calentar el interior. Así, en lugar de producir todo el calor a partir de la electricidad, lo trasladan de un lugar a otro.
Gracias a eso, algunos equipos proporcionan varias unidades de energía térmica por cada unidad de electricidad consumida, pero hay que tener en cuenta que su rendimiento disminuye si las condiciones exteriores son especialmente frías.

Aumentar mucho la temperatura del mundo cuando sentimos frío es uno de los errores más habituales, ya que esto no calienta antes la habitación. Además, fijar 26 grados en lugar de 21 no garantiza que el aparato funcione más rápido, ya que estamos indicando la temperatura que queremos alcanzar.

articles.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang summoned by Congress over Chinese espionage concerns
articles.summary:
Top Republican lawmakers have asked Jensen Huang to appear before Congress to answer questions after it was reported that US intelligence officials believe Nvidia’s chief executive has been targeted by a Chinese spying operation.
The chairs of the House committees on China, foreign affairs, and intelligence wrote to Huang this week asking him to appear before a joint closed-door briefing for their committees on November 18.
“Recent reports raise significant national security concerns regarding the People’s Republic of China’s access to sensitive US technology and information,” representatives John Moolenaar, Brian Mast, and Rick Crawford wrote.
“The issue of PRC infiltration and access to cutting-edge US technology is core to the investigative work of our three committees this Congress. It is vital that Congress determines the extent to which US national security has been placed at risk,” the lawmakers added.
The New York Times last week wrote that US intelligence officials believed Huang had been the target of a Chinese spy operation. The concerns center on a Chinese woman named Alice Huang, an executive at Megaspeed, a Singapore-based cloud company that has bought billions of dollars of Nvidia’s chips.
Nvidia has rejected the claims and on Thursday would not say if Huang would appear before Congress. “Meetings with customers are part of a CEO’s job. Jensen talks with thousands of customer executives every year,” the company said.

articles.title: AI’s ability to find cyber flaws outpacing enterprises’ capacity to fix them: Pala Alto Networks' Nikesh Arora

AI’s ability to find cyber flaws outpacing firms’ capacity to fix them: Palo Alto Networks' Nikesh Arora
Nikesh Arora, Chairman and CEO of Palo Alto Networks, has called for faster and more collaborative approaches to vulnerability management.
Nikesh Arora, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Palo Alto Networks, has raised concerns about the growing use of frontier artificial intelligence (AI) models to identify software vulnerabilities and link them into potential attack paths.
While these capabilities can help strengthen cybersecurity, they could also give attackers faster ways to exploit weaknesses in enterprise systems. The bigger challenge, Arora notes in a LinkedIn post, is ensuring that organisations can verify, prioritise and fix vulnerabilities at the same pace at which AI can discover them.
“Most organizations do not have capacity to patch at the speed needed, especially the smaller ones,” Arora wrote. Smaller businesses often lack security specialists, while larger ones must test fixes against existing applications. He also says models identify different weaknesses, so one model cannot provide complete coverage.
Finding a flaw is only the start. Teams must confirm it, assess the risk, develop a fix, test for disruption and deploy it. False positives, or incorrect alerts, waste time, while untested patches can disrupt services.

Depuis la sortie de Windows 11 24H2 en 2024, Microsoft s'est contentée de mises à jour annuelles relativement modestes sur le plan technique. Les versions 25H2 et 26H2 reposent sur la même base et s'installent rapidement, grâce à un petit paquet chargé d'activer des fonctionnalités déjà distribuées au fil des mises à jour mensuelles. Mais l'éditeur préparerait un changement de taille pour 2027. Selon les informations de Tom Warren, journaliste à The Verge, Windows 11 27H2 devrait bénéficier d'une refonte plus profonde, trois ans après la dernière évolution majeure de sa plateforme.
Une nouvelle base technique pour Windows 11
Contrairement aux deux précédentes versions annuelles, Windows 11 27H2 ne se limiterait donc pas à activer des fonctionnalités déjà présentes sur les PC. Microsoft prévoirait de remplacer ou de faire évoluer plusieurs composants importants du système, ce qui nécessiterait une installation plus conséquente et davantage de tests. D'après Tom Warren, les premières versions d'essai pourraient ainsi être proposées aux membres du programme Windows Insider bien avant le mois de juin, période à laquelle avaient commencé les tests de 25H2 et 26H2.

What just happened? Refrigeration units operated by Établissement Français du Sang (EFS), France's national blood service, have been hit by a cyberattack. It is the latest in a series of intrusions targeting cold-storage controllers across Europe. No blood products or other biological materials were lost. The attack triggered EFS's alarm system, prompting staff to move the affected stock to functioning storage units before it could spoil.
The French Health Ministry said it is closely monitoring the situation and confirmed that no biological materials were lost. The intrusion appears to have targeted refrigeration equipment at three sites, reportedly including one in Burgundy-Franche-Comté.
The attackers did not breach EFS directly. The agency says the intrusion occurred at one of its service providers, which several outlets have identified as Coolworld, a refrigeration rental company. Coolworld has published a notice attributing the incident to "remote monitoring software" used in its systems. It traced the problem to "a component from a third-party supplier," but has released no further technical details.
Without those details, it is difficult to determine how the attackers gained access. In the earlier supermarket attacks, they targeted refrigeration equipment that was directly exposed to the internet. articles.title: Pentagon offers battery startup 6K $250M loan to build US factory | TechCrunch
articles.summary:
Batteries are everywhere, even on the battlefield, which helps explain the Pentagon’s recent interest in building more domestic manufacturing capacity.
The 12-year-old, North Andover, Massachusetts-based startup 6K announced Thursday that it won conditional approval for a $250 million loan from the Department of Defense to build a factory in Tennessee. The plant will use a unique microwave-powered process to produce battery materials that don’t rely on Chinese suppliers.
The company previously received a $50 million grant from the Department of Energy under the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law, though that 2023 grant was canceled by the Trump administration in a chaotic sweep of Biden-era awards, forcing 6K to reapply.
The factory was originally slated to open in 2024, but the grant cancelation and uncertainties in the EV market forced the company to rejigger its plans.
6K’s manufacturing process uses microwaves to heat metals into a plasma and then deposit them onto a surface, reducing the number of steps required to make cathode material, a key battery component. The company says the process can work on a number of different battery types, including lithium iron phosphate (LFP).

Bom, se esses sistemas funcionam até hoje, não há razão para trocá-los, certo? Não é bem assim. A malha aérea atual é muito diferente da que existia há 30 ou 40 anos, tendo muito mais voos. Sistemas obsoletos podem simplesmente não oferecer o suporte necessário a essa demanda, bem como estão mais suscetíveis a falhas.

articles.title: « Être une femme, ça aide » : Sophie Adenot raconte comment son corps a vécu l'espace (en vidéo)

Au total, elle a vécu 237 jours dans l’espace (un record européen pour un vol unique). Elle a ensuite passé 3 semaines en réadaptation au Centre des astronautes européens de Cologne, en Allemagne, avant cette conférence de presse au siège parisien de l’ESA.
Elle a surtout décrit un corps qui s’est bien adapté à la vie en orbite, loin de l’image d’un organisme uniquement malmené par l’apesanteur. Pour en savoir plus sur son témoignage, vous pouvez regarder notre vidéo complète sur YouTube.
« Être dans l’espace pour le corps féminin, c’est quand même la panacée », selon Sophie Adenot
Sophie Adenot livre un témoignage qu’on entend rarement, le métier d’astronaute étant encore majoritairement exercé par des hommes : selon elle, le corps féminin se sent particulièrement bien dans l’ISS. Elle explique que les variations hormonales et biologiques régulières préparent en quelque sorte les femmes aux changements profonds d’environnement. Le cycle menstruel ou les grossesses habitueraient peut-être le corps à réagir à des stress extérieurs, avance-t-elle prudemment.…

articles.title: Could potential AI clones of GTA VI force a quicker official port?
articles.summary:
Yesterday, when reporting on emerging efforts to pipe the console version of GTA VI through a PC’s DLSS-powered Nvidia GPU, we mentioned in passing that PC players could instead just wait for the AI-assisted decompilation port that will no doubt be coming in short order. Now, a former Rockstar tech director says he thinks that exact threat could cause the developer to work faster on the official PC version of its soon-to-release crime/lifestyle simulator.
Obbe Vermeij hasn’t worked at Rockstar since 2009, but in a new interview with Rock Paper Shotgun, he recalled how artists for the PC version of the original top-down Grand Theft Auto were incensed when the console version squashed the game’s 256-color textures down to 16 colors for the PS1 release.
“So it always has been that sort of awkward relationship between PC and the console,” Vermeij said. “So in those days, it was like PC first and then console second, even though that didn’t really make much sense for the sales, because the PlayStation versions sold way better.”
Those sales caused Rockstar to pivot hard toward the console side of the business, with oft-delayed PC ports of its major games only hitting many months or even many years after their console counterparts. It’s a trend that Rockstar has stuck with even as many formerly console-focused game publishers have started treating the PC as an equally relevant platform and as the line between PCs and consoles itself has gotten much fuzzier in recent years.

“Describe an idea in chat, and Muse builds a space for you, whether that’s a tracker, a planner or a project board,” Meta says.

“Connect the apps you use, and your spaces keep themselves up to date in the background, so new concert dates, price changes, or savings progress show up without you having to ask,” the company says.

Estas compañías son los mayores fabricantes de chips HBM (High Bandwidth Memory o memoria de alto ancho de banda) del planeta, las memorias que están acaparando los centros de datos para aplicaciones de inteligencia artificial (IA).
El auge que está experimentando esta tecnología desde finales de 2022 ha catapultado el negocio no solo de estas empresas surcoreanas, sino también el de la estadounidense Micron Technology. El índice KOSPI registró una subida espectacular durante el primer semestre de 2026 gracias en gran medida a los buenos resultados económicos que obtuvieron Samsung y SK hynix, pero hoy se ha desplomado. Ha caído un 8,8% durante la sesión, lo que obligó a los responsables de la bolsa a tomar una decisión drástica: suspender temporalmente la negociación durante 20 minutos.

articles.title: Hundreds of Artex AI hacking tools found publicly exposed to the web | TechCrunch
articles.summary:
Security researchers have discovered hundreds of copies of a Chinese-made AI hacking tool publicly exposed to the internet for anyone to access, potentially allowing outsiders to launch cyberattacks against unsuspecting targets.
The hacking software, called Artex, is an open source autonomous penetration testing tool, meaning software that automatically probes computer systems for weaknesses, and it’s been linked to several cyberattacks since its public release in July. As open source software, it’s free for anyone to download and run on their own servers, making it a popular tool for those who cannot access Anthropic or OpenAI’s most advanced cybersecurity AI models for discovering security vulnerabilities. Microsoft has previously described Artex as a system of AI agents that can conduct cyberattacks “from reconnaissance through data exfiltration with little needed human interaction.”
In a blog post, cybersecurity firm Censys, which scans the internet for exposed or vulnerable systems, said that it identified more than 800 distinct deployments of Artex that were accessible from the web without needing a password to log in.
Silas Cutler, principal security researcher at Censys who wrote the blog post, said that not every instance of Artex is operated maliciously and many are used for authorized testers. But it’s unclear why hundreds of these Artex systems are exposed to the web, as the software does not require them to be accessible from the internet.

articles.title: Microsoft Paint tem falha grave que permite ataques remotos • Tecnoblog
articles.summary:
Microsoft Paint tem falha grave que permite ataques remotos
Microsoft já liberou uma correção para o Paint, mas talvez você tenha que ir atrás dela.
Um software inocente como o Microsoft Paint não dá problema, certo? Dá, sim. Recentemente, uma falha grave foi encontrada na ferramenta de edição de imagens nativa do Windows 11. A vulnerabilidade permite a execução remota de código malicioso no computador alvejado. A Microsoft já liberou a correção, mas existe um porém com relação a ela.
O problema recebeu a identificação CVE-2026-83844 e registrou a pontuação 8,1 (de 10) na escala de gravidade CVSS 3.1. Trata-se de uma vulnerabilidade do tipo “Out-of-bounds Read” (algo como “leitura fora dos limites”, em tradução livre), que ocorre quando um software tenta acessar uma área de memória que não está dentro dos limites predefinidos para determinada operação.
No caso do Paint, a falha pode ser explorada por meio da abertura de um arquivo de imagem malicioso que, como tal, induz o software a ler dados fora dos limites de memória designados a ele.
Essa ação pode corromper estruturas funcionais ou mecanismos de segurança de modo a permitir que o invasor injete e execute códigos no sistema usando os privilégios de acesso do usuário atual. As consequências podem ser variadas, indo desde a captura de dados sigilosos até a execução local de malwares.
A Microsoft corrigiu a vulnerabilidade no Paint 11.2609.401.0. Então, basta ter essa versão (ou superior) para se livrar do perigo. O problem…

An infant in Wisconsin has died of measles, the first measles death in the state since 1990, officials reported Thursday. The death comes amid an outbreak in the Badger State that has stricken over 430 people across 13 counties this year.
“Any death of a child is a tragedy, and even more so when it is related to a vaccine-preventable disease,” Wisconsin Health Secretary Kirsten Johnson said in a statement. “Measles can cause serious illness and death, and it is important for all Wisconsinites to evaluate their risk and take steps to protect themselves and their family.”
The baby’s death is the third measles fatality nationally just this week, following the death of a New York child reported on Monday and another death in Pennsylvania reported on Wednesday. The Pennsylvania death was of an unvaccinated person in Jefferson County; the state health department did not provide additional details, such as the age of the person. The state’s explosive, ongoing measles outbreak has led to 1,467 cases so far this year.
In all, there have been nine reported measles deaths this year in the US, eight of which have been confirmed by state officials. The deaths include the baby’s death in Wisconsin, the child’s death in New York, and seven deaths (six confirmed) in Pennsylvania, including two babies, a healthy teen, and several adults with underlying health conditions.

“Si tiene el dinero, adelante”, dijo el ejecutivo. Y agregó que, para competir en una industria que los operadores “profesionalizaron en los últimos 20 años”, la respuesta era darle la bienvenida: “Welcome to the party” (bienvenido a la fiesta).

Le moteur réutilisable Prometheus enchaîne les tirs en une journée, avec une première

Cette tour d'essai de 70 mètres appartient à l'ESA, l'Agence spatiale européenne, et est exploitée par le DLR, le centre aérospatial allemand. Invasores alteraram remotamente a temperatura de equipamentos que armazenavam plasma e amostras.
Equipamentos de armazenagem de plasma e amostras de sangue foram alvo de um ciberataque em três instalações do Estabelecimento Francês de Sangue (EFS). Os freezers, normalmente mantidos próximos a -30 ºC, chegaram a ser programados para atingir 110 ºC.

O ataque ocorreu em 2 de novembro. Segundo o EFS, os invasores modificaram remotamente os limites de temperatura e os parâmetros de degelo dos sistemas para valores extremamente altos. Parte dos equipamentos armazenava bolsas de plasma destinadas a transfusões e à fabricação de medicamentos.
De acordo com a imprensa local, alarmes foram acionados antes que os produtos atingissem temperaturas capazes de danificá-los. Dependendo da unidade, os equipamentos foram colocados novamente sob controle, desligados ou tiveram o conteúdo transferido para locais seguros por funcionários, segundo a Associated Press.

There are optimistic plans for spaceflight, and then there are optimistic plans.
AST SpaceMobile is a Texas-based, publicly traded company building very large satellites to provide direct-to-cell communications on Earth. But it has been having trouble finding rides to space. So on Friday, AST announced that it is developing a medium-lift rocket, named Blacklift, which will have the capacity to lift 20 metric tons to low-Earth orbit. Oh, and the company said it would start launching commercially in late 2028.
“The Blacklift rocket is the springboard to significantly expand our total addressable market, providing AST SpaceMobile with regular unconstrained access to orbit and providing for most favorable owner’s economics in the industry,” said Abel Avellan, founder, chairman, and CEO of AST SpaceMobile, in a news release.
To anyone with even a basic understanding of rockets, that timeline is wildly, fantastically, and stupidly optimistic. Still, the announcement is worth examining because it underscores two important trends in today’s launch industry.
First, it’s becoming increasingly apparent that satellite operators planning to deploy large constellations need to secure launch capacity years in advance, as Amazon did nearly half a decade ago. And if they can’t secure that capacity on favorable terms, they are now considering taking the extraordinary step of developing their own rockets.

Ce 3 novembre, il a en effet signé une proclamation baptisée « Déclaration américaine de liberté dans l’espace ». Et ça vaut clairement le coup d’œil.
Une « civilisation interplanétaire » made in USA
Le texte tient en quelques paragraphes, mais son message est on ne peut plus ambigu. Car s’il assure que le Système solaire et tout l’espace au-delà de la Terre sont « la province de tous les humains », il ajoute aussitôt qu’ils sont « ouverts à l’exploration, au développement, à l’utilisation et à l’établissement d’une présence permanente par les citoyens américains ».
Surtout, il met en avant l’idéologie défendue par le républicain, puisqu’il est question de « forger une civilisation interplanétaire fondée sur les droits durables et inaliénables de la liberté et de la liberté individuelle ». Trump promet, en outre, d’emporter dans l’espace les « valeurs sacrées de foi et de liberté » du pays, « partout où nous irons ». Il cite, évidemment, les premiers pas d’Apollo 11 sur la Lune, mais aussi les rovers sur Mars et la récente mission Artemis II.

articles.title: Hitzeschutz, Waldumbau, Mega-Deiche: Wie uns Klimaanpassungen retten sollen

Hitzeschutz, Waldumbau, Mega-Deiche: Wie uns Klimaanpassungen retten sollen
Anpassung an den Klimawandel galt vielen lange als Kapitulation. Spätestens dieser Sommer hat gezeigt, dass wir uns diese Haltung nicht mehr leisten können. Rund 16.000 hitzebedingte Todesfälle hat das Robert Koch-Institut 2026 verzeichnet. Damit ist die Klimakrise auch im Alltag der deutschen Bevölkerung angekommen.
Und dieser Alltag wird zunehmend härter. Die fossilen CO2-Emissionen sind 2025 erneut auf einen Rekordwert gestiegen und die Welt steuert laut dem neuen Emissions Gap Report der Vereinten Nationen auf 2,8 Grad Erwärmung bis Ende des Jahrhunderts zu. Und das Klima reagiert träge: Selbst wenn wir heute radikal gegensteuern würden, wirkt das bereits ausgestoßene CO2 noch über Jahrzehnte nach.
MIT Technology Review: Ab sofort online bestellbar und im Handel.
Die neue MIT Technology Review jetzt bestellen!
Klimaanpassung – es mangelt jedenfalls nicht an Ideen
Neben Klimaschutz wird also die Anpassung immer wichtiger – nicht nur um Leben zu retten, sondern auch aus wirtschaftlichen Gründen: Jeder in die Anpassung investierte Euro erspart fünf bis zehn Euro an Kosten für Schäden. Seit 2024 gibt es das Klimaanpassungsgesetz und es mangelt weder an Wissen noch an Ideen. Trotzdem steht auf dem neu gestalteten Berliner Gendarmenmarkt kein einziger Baum.

articles.title: OpenAI entdeckt und schließt dank KI-Agenten 948 Sicherheitslücken im Linux-Kernel

KI-Agenten können dabei helfen, Sicherheitslücken zu entdecken. OpenAI reicht das aber nicht aus. Der Mutterkonzern von ChatGPT will eine Systematik kreieren, in der KI-Agenten nach dem Auffinden der Sicherheitslücken auch gleich Patches dafür entwickeln lassen.
KI-Agenten entdecken 948 Exploits im Linux-Kernel
Ein solcher Prototyp hat im Linux-Kernel 948 Exploits entdeckt und diese auch gleich geschlossen. OpenAI präsentierte diese Ergebnisse in einem Blogbeitrag. Diese 948 Lücken sollen es Angreifer:innen ermöglichen, auf anfälligen Systemen ihre Rechte auszuweiten und Root-Zugriff zu erlangen.
Zahl der entdeckten Sicherheitslücken ist dank KI immer größer geworden

'Disenchanted by Big Tech' — Why everyday people are switching to Linux to take back control of their privacy
You don't have to be a hacker to leave Windows behind
What do a clinical psychologist from Queensland, an artist from Atlanta, a bio-behavioural scientist from North Carolina, and a tech engineer from Hungary have in common? In spite of their different levels of tech knowledge, all four converted to Linux within the last six months to regain control of their privacy and data.
Nearly a year ago, reports of millions of new Linux downloads signalled a shift in attitude amongst average digital users. The catalyst was the end of free support for Windows 10, followed by Microsoft’s aggressive promotion of Windows 11 and increasingly intrusive data-collection practices that sparked user dissatisfaction.
While ever-expanding surveillance seems to be the hallmark of major tech companies, increasingly user-friendly Linux desktop environments and installation programs, along with LLMs eager to help with configuration issues, are enabling even the least tech-savvy users to reclaim their digital freedom.
TechRadar spoke to those who have already switched to Linux to understand their reasons, how difficult it was to change operating systems, and whether we all need to do so to really be more private online.

articles.title: The folks behind John Wick are back with Karōshi trailer
articles.summary:
Those of us missing the John Wick universe can take heart, because Chad Stahelski—who created that franchise—is coming back early next year with a new dystopian action film. It’s called Karōshi (a Japanese term that means “death overwork”), and Lionsgate released a killer trailer that puts this film at the top of my list of “must see” movies of 2027.
Dying from working too hard is a very real phenomenon, not just in Japan and much of Asia, but also in Sweden, where some 700 workers die each year from overwork. The physical cause is usually stress-related heart attacks or strokes, as well as suicide (karōjisatsu in Japan). Writer/director Takashi Doscher has transported that concept to a grim, futuristic corporate Manhattan, specifically a company called Ikigai Technologies. Per the official premise:
Karōshi is an action-thriller set in a near-future Manhattan, where corporate loyalty and cultural tradition have reshaped everyday life. When a mysterious outsider infiltrates a powerful company after a worker’s death, he exposes the violent system hidden beneath its polished surface.
Teo Yoo (Past Lives) stars as the aptly named Hiro, who is clearly out for vengeance against the offending corporation. The cast also includes Takehiro Hira, so memorable in the 2024 miniseries Shōgun, as well as Giancarlo Esposito, Cynthia Erivo, Bill Camp, Richard Harmon, Isabel May, and Show Kasamatsu.

Hoyocasero es un pueblo del valle del Alto Alberche, en Ávila, con 294 habitantes y a más de 1.300 metros de altitud. En el balcón del Ayuntamiento del pueblo, junto a las banderas oficiales y según la descripción de Ávilared, llevaba un RIP y una cruz roja. Qué pasó. La versión disponible es la del alcalde, Iván Picós (PP). Según su comunicado, una o varias personas sin identificar colocaron el ataúd en la madrugada del sábado al domingo, coincidiendo con Halloween. Él estaba fuera del pueblo. El domingo por la mañana un concejal lo vio y avisó a otro. Los tres acordaron quitarlo. Picós sostiene que Halloween no justifica usar el balcón de un edificio institucional.
La primera denuncia. Se conoció el lunes y es electoral, no penal. Frente Amplio, la nueva coalición progresista que se estrena en estas generales, acudió a la Junta Electoral de Zona de Ávila contra el Ayuntamiento. Alega que un edificio público no puede exhibir mensajes de este tipo. Airbnb veut vous accompagner dans la préparation d’un séjour, sa réservation et les problèmes rencontrés en cours de route grâce à un agent IA. Son déploiement doit commencer au premier semestre 2027, sans calendrier précisé pour la France.
Trouver un logement qui plaît à tout le monde, comparer les emplacements, vérifier les disponibilités : avant les vacances, il y a souvent quelques soirées de recherches. Airbnb veut simplifier ces étapes avec son propre agent IA, dont il vient de préciser le fonctionnement. L’idée est de vous aider à choisir et à réserver, puis de rester disponible lorsque le séjour ne se déroule pas comme prévu.
Une interface qui compose votre voyage avec des cartes, des photos et des comparatifs
Airbnb affirme ne pas croire qu’un chatbot classique soit la bonne manière de planifier un voyage. Le service décrit plutôt une interface construite autour de la demande du voyageur. L’agent puisera dans une bibliothèque de centaines d’éléments — cartes, photos, comparatifs, calendriers et itinéraires — pour les assembler en temps réel selon les besoins.
La plateforme défend ainsi une approche plus visuelle que celle d’un chatbot classique. Chercher une maison pour les vacances ne se résume pas à obtenir une adresse : on regarde les chambres, on vérifie la distance avec la plage et on envoie les favoris aux personnes qui partent avec nous. Airbnb veut conserver cette exploration, tout en aidant à trier les possibilités et à passer à la réservation.

A division bench of the Delhi High Court has dismissed an appeal by Unity Bank, upholding the interim protection granted to BharatPe's parent company RIPL (Resilient Innovations Private Limited) under the Shareholders’ Agreement and affirming the order of a single judge.
The court has now, on two occasions, declined to let the bank and its promoter proceed on reserved matters without the prior written consent of RIPL, as the Shareholders’ Agreement (SHA) requires.
Rejecting the bank’s explanation that it had sought RIPL’s consent on Reserved Matters through an “inadvertent error”, the bench called the plea an “argument of desperation and nothing more”. How cutting corporate reporting red tape could help businesses focus on growth
Cutting reporting red tape gives businesses more time for growth
In September 2026, the government announced plans to cut the administrative burden on businesses, freeing them to focus on growth. Its proposals to simplify corporate reporting, including lighter-touch requirements for SMEs and wider audit exemptions, could save businesses more than £450 million a year.
With some companies’ statutory annual reports and accounts now averaging 98,000 words, the reforms reflect a broader push towards more proportionate reporting and less unnecessary administration.

Diamond Foundry Inc. today announced a major milestone in the history of materials technology: the creation of the first-ever D200mm single-crystal diamond, measuring 200 millimeters in diameter. Una falla de seguridad permitía acceder sin contraseña a algunos servidores Linux que usan OpenSSH, el programa encargado de proteger las conexiones remotas. Para aprovecharla, un atacante solo debía enviar una contraseña especialmente larga, de entre 257 y 1.024 caracteres. La corrección se publicó el 5 de noviembre.
La vulnerabilidad, llamada “sshole”, fue hallada por Özgün Kültekin, investigador de la firma de seguridad Wakefield. No afecta a todos los equipos con Linux: se concentra en configuraciones específicas, presentes sobre todo en servidores livianos, servicios en la nube y dispositivos conectados a internet.
El problema alcanza a sistemas que usan una variante de Linux llamada musl, una pieza básica de software que ayuda a los programas a funcionar. También deben tener habilitado el ingreso con contraseña y carecer de una herramienta adicional de autenticación conocida como PAM.
Alpine Linux, un sistema muy utilizado para crear versiones preconfiguradas de servidores y servicios en la nube, traía esa combinación de forma predeterminada. Wakefield también señaló posibles riesgos en OpenWrt, usado en routers, y en Buildroot y Yocto, empleados para crear el software de dispositivos conectados.
Los administradores de Alpine resumieron el riesgo de forma directa: “Un atacante que pueda llegar a tu puerto SSH, la puerta de acceso remoto del servidor, puede entrar sin saber ninguna contraseña”. Según indicaron, basta con una conexión y el intento no requiere repetirse.

Nvidia, Tesla, Meta, Microsoft : la chute a emporté tout le monde, et la secousse a déjà gagné l'Asie et l'Europe. Nvidia, le fabricant des puces qui font tourner ChatGPT et ses rivaux, a perdu plus de 9 % de sa valeur, soit 440 milliards de dollars envolés. Tesla a plongé de près de 11 %, et Meta, Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon et Apple ont suivi.
Les cent plus grosses entreprises technologiques cotées à New York n'avaient plus autant chuté en une séance depuis les premiers jours du Covid, en mars 2020. Le lendemain matin, la Bourse de Séoul a dû suspendre ses échanges pendant vingt minutes pour enrayer la panique.
La veille encore, les marchés avaient accueilli sans broncher le résultat des élections de mi-mandat américaines. "Nous pensions être tirés d'affaire après le rebond du marché au lendemain des élections de mi-mandat, mais soudain c'est un véritable bain de sang", a résumé Jose Torres, analyste chez Interactive Brokers, auprès de l'AFP.

New Cohesity research has revealed UK businesses could be putting themselves at risk of cyberattacks because they're prioritizing recovery speed over quality.
This applies to three in four (74%) UK organizations, according to the report, with nearly as many (70%) failing to even check that attackers have been fully removed from breached systems after a cyberattack.
Expenses back this up too, because three-quarters (76%) of the businesses surveyed admitted that cyber resilience investments focus too heavily on prevention rather than response and recovery.
Cybersecurity isn't focusing enough on effective recovery
Crucially, Cohesity's data shows that business leaders are virtually clueless about the state of their IT teams' readiness, with half (52%) of UK CEOs expecting basic business operations to resume within just 24 hours. A false sense of security could partly be why budgets aren't being directed to the right causes.
It's also clear that the responsibility for deciding which systems get restored first is still pretty uncertain – 23% say it should be on the entire board, 21% pin it on the CTO, 20% on the CEO and 14% on a security advisory board.

articles.title: Perseverance acaba de descubrir algo en el polvo de Marte que complica mucho nuestras posibilidades de colonizarlo

El objetivo era, una vez en el planeta rojo, exponerlos a sus condiciones ambientales, y comprobar qué tan bien las soportaba cada tejido. Sobre todo, había interés en analizar el polvo del regolito, ya que se sabe que en la Luna está compuesto por partículas afiladas, muy irritantes y abrasivas, tanto para la piel como para las mucosas. Por suerte, se ha comprobado que las partículas de polvo marciano son mucho más redondeadas. Pero ahí terminan las buenas noticias.
De cascos a guantes. En total, Perseverance cargaba con cinco muestras de tejidos de trajes de astronautas. Estas incluían un trozo de visera de casco de policarbonato; un fragmento de un material resistente a cortes, llamado Vectran, que se usa para confeccionar guantes; dos tipos de teflón, que tienen propiedades antiadherentes repelentes al polvo; y un material comúnmente utilizado para trajes espaciales, llamado Ortho-Fabric. Este último consta de varias capas. como el Nomex, un material que se encuentra en los trajes de bomberos por ser resistente al fuego; el Gore-Tex, que es impermeable pero transpirable; y el Kevlar, un material que se usa en chalecos antibalas por su gran resistencia. Se trata de tejidos muy útiles en la Tierra, ¿pero protegen frente a las inclemencias marcianas?

Why responsive stores need orchestration, not more screens
The next interactive store won’t wait to be touched
For years, the retail industry treated the touchscreen as shorthand for interactivity. If shoppers could browse an endless aisle, customize a product or trigger an animation, the store was considered interactive.
That definition is beginning to look dated. The next generation of interactive stores will not be defined by what shoppers touch, but by what the environment understands — and how appropriately it responds.
Managing Director of nsign.
This is an important distinction. A store can be filled with digital displays, interactive kiosks, sensors and immersive installations and still behave like a static space. The content may be visually impressive, yet remain unchanged regardless of what is happening on the sales floor.
The same promotion runs when inventory is plentiful or nearly depleted. The same message appears during a quiet morning and a crowded evening. Every screen is managed as a separate endpoint rather than as part of a coordinated customer experience.
That is technology added to a store, not a truly interactive store.
Digital channels
Digital channels have already established a different expectation. Websites and apps routinely adapt to location, browsing behavior, product availability and the stage of the purchasing journey. articles.title: The AI boom's missing balance-sheet question: What has actually been verified? - SiliconANGLE
articles.summary:
The AI boom’s missing balance-sheet question: What has actually been verified?
Artificial intelligence infrastructure commitments are growing faster than the evidence connecting contracted capacity to sustained economic value.
I spent 13 years on the floor of the New York Stock Exchange. One lesson stayed with me long after the trading jackets disappeared: A transaction could be executed, documented and perfectly valid while the assumptions that made it attractive proved less durable than anyone expected.
That distinction matters in the artificial intelligence infrastructure boom. We can believe AI will transform productivity and still ask whether each financing, data-center expansion or long-term capacity agreement is supported by evidence that can survive the investment’s life.
The industry is making commitments across different clocks. Compute contracts may run for years. Debt can mature decades from now.
Servers have much shorter technology cycles. Power infrastructure, transmission upgrades and buildings may outlast several generations of the equipment they were built to support. Meanwhile, enterprise customers are still learning what they will use, how intensively they will use it and what they will pay.
None of this proves the investments are unsound. It does create a question that belongs beside revenue forecasts and capital budgets: What exactly has been verified at the moment an institution decides to rely on a promise?

The Arch Linux-based distribution Omarchy 4.5 has been released, the project's first expansion beyond x86-64. It adds Apple Silicon support, a new floating desktop mode, and a few other updates. Legendary games maker Hideo Kojima is known for the creativity of his output, from the Metal Gear Solid series to Death Stranding, so it’s unsurprising to hear that he has strong opinions on the use of AI in video games. And in a fresh interview, he told readers exactly where he feels AI falls flat compared to human-made artistic expression.
Speaking to Japanese site Game*Spark, Kojima said that while it’s good that AI has improved efficiency, “the fun isn’t in finishing the picture. articles.title: Mars n’est pas morte, une sonde européenne détecte les signes d’un magma endormi sous ses volcans
articles.summary:
Au-dessus de fissures volcaniques sur Mars, la sonde européenne ExoMars TGO a détecté du chlorure d'hydrogène, un gaz que rejettent souvent les volcans terrestres. Un indice que la planète rouge garde de la chaleur sous sa croûte, voire des refuges pour la vie.
Mars pourrait abriter une activité volcanique en sommeil, selon une étude internationale fondée sur les données de la sonde européenne ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter (TGO). À contre-saison, l'orbiteur de l'ESA a repéré du chlorure d'hydrogène au-dessus des mêmes fissures du volcan Alba Mons, un signal qui pourrait trahir un magma endormi sous la surface. La découverte relance l'éternel débat sur l'activité de la planète rouge, et pourrait bien indiquer aux scientifiques où chercher la vie.
Sur Mars, un gaz volcanique qui n'en fait qu'à sa tête
Le chlorure d'hydrogène (HCl), TGO l'a signalé pour la première fois dans l'atmosphère martienne dès 2021. Comme ce gaz s'échappe couramment des évents volcaniques sur Terre, donc par des fissures et des fumerolles, les chercheurs se demandaient s'il en allait de même là-haut. Mais pour l'essentiel, il suit un calendrier bien réglé, car il culmine pendant l'hiver de l'hémisphère nord puis disparaît presque entièrement l'été, un va-et-vient qui semble surtout lié aux cycles de la poussière et de l'eau. Presque, car une exception revient avec une régularité d'horloge.

Whether you're a cyclist, driver, or both, we can probably all agree that a better awareness of who's using the road is helpful for everyone — and Garmin is rumored to be working on a new feature that would pass on the location of cyclists to the Waze app.
This comes from Gadgets & Wearables, reporting on hidden code discovered in the latest version of the Garmin Connect app. That code includes the text strings "share location with Waze", "share your rides with Waze", and "Waze location sharing", which is telling.

El Gobierno de Japón presentó el 6 de noviembre un paquete de medidas de emergencia contra la ola de ciberataques que expuso datos personales en el país. La primera ministra, Sanae Takaichi, y sus ministros aprobaron el uso de IA para detectar fallas en sistemas, la creación de equipos de expertos y un gasto inicial de 10.000 millones de yenes.
La cifra equivale a unos USD 63 millones y saldrá de la reserva presupuestaria del año fiscal 2026, según Kyodo. El Gobierno la aprobó antes de presentar el paquete. Es un monto de partida para financiar las primeras acciones, no el costo total del plan.
Según Jiji Press, unos 2.000 millones de yenes servirán para revisar con IA las vulnerabilidades de los sistemas del Estado. Otros 4.100 millones irán a equipos y entrenamiento de la policía para investigar ataques, y 3.800 millones al refuerzo de la seguridad informática de la Agencia Digital.
El detonante fue una serie de filtraciones de datos personales por accesos no autorizados. Kyodo citó como ejemplo el ataque contra el proveedor de internet GMO Internet Group, a cuyos responsables se les atribuye haber exigido un rescate.
Equipos de élite y acceso a servidores atacantes
El paquete se apoya en cuatro ejes: reforzar la seguridad básica con IA, mejorar la recolección y el análisis de información, responder a los ataques con una estrategia y apoyar a las víctimas para limitar el daño, según Kyodo.

articles.title: Cette faille Android peut condamner votre smartphone à redémarrer en boucle, et Google ne compte pas la corriger
articles.summary:
Une APK volontairement piégée par des chercheurs a plongé un Pixel 10 dans une boucle de redémarrages sans fin, sans que l'application ait jamais été ouverte. Baptisée GhostMap, cette faille d'Android ne fait pour l'instant l'objet d'aucun correctif de sécurité annoncé par Google.
Un téléphone qui plante, ça se redémarre. Si le problème persiste, on tente le mode sans échec pour chercher une éventuelle application fautive et, au besoin, la désinstaller. Mais que faire quand le smartphone replante avant même d'afficher l'écran d'accueil ? C'est ce que les chercheurs de Bitdefender ont réussi à provoquer en exploitant une faille du système baptisée GhostMap. Android se retrouve alors piégé dans une boucle de plantages dont il est presque impossible de sortir, à moins de procéder à une réinitialisation d'usine et donc d'accepter de s'asseoir sur ses données non sauvegardées.
Une découverte fortuite aux conséquences inattendues
Il aura fallu que les chercheurs de Bitdefender se retrouvent aux prises avec un cheval de Troie bancaire récalcitrant pour mettre le doigt sur GhostMap. À chaque tentative d'installation, le logiciel malveillant faisait planter leurs émulateurs avant même de pouvoir s'exécuter. En cherchant à comprendre ce qui clochait, l'équipe a découvert une faille d'Android que les auteurs du malware avaient déclenchée sans le savoir.

articles.title: TikTok enfrenta una posible multa millonaria de la UE: le acusan de atrapar a sus usuarios en “madrigueras” de contenido dañino
articles.summary:
La Comisión Europea concluyó de forma preliminar que el feed “Para ti” de TikTok infringe la Ley de Servicios Digitales por empujar a los usuarios a “madrigueras” de contenido dañino para la salud mental. El hallazgo puede terminar en una multa de hasta el 6 por ciento de la facturación anual mundial de la empresa.
Bruselas presentó el 6 de noviembre sus conclusiones sobre el sistema de recomendaciones de la aplicación. Según el comunicado, cuanto más interactúa una persona con un tipo de contenido, más videos parecidos le muestra el algoritmo, incluso cuando tratan sobre tristeza, aislamiento o imagen corporal.
La Comisión sostiene que ese diseño puede perjudicar la salud mental, en especial la de menores y adultos vulnerables. Entre los efectos que menciona figuran mayor ansiedad, insatisfacción con el propio cuerpo, menor autoestima y el empeoramiento de trastornos alimentarios ya existentes.
Los hallazgos abarcan dos fallas: TikTok no evaluó de forma adecuada los riesgos de su feed y las medidas que tomó para reducirlos no son eficaces. Según la Comisión, las herramientas para diversificar el contenido apenas reducen la repetición y el botón “No me interesa” puede no alcanzar para cambiar lo que aparece.
Qué le pide Bruselas a TikTok
La Comisión propone cambios concretos en el diseño. TikTok debería dar más peso a lo que los usuarios piden de forma expresa, dejar de usar el tiempo de visualización como señal de recomendación, facilitar los controles y probar su algoritmo …

Plus d’une centaine d’organisations réparties dans quinze pays européens s’unissent pour demander l’instauration d’un moratoire immédiat sur le développement des nouveaux datacenters dédiés à faire fonctionner les services d'intelligence artificielle. Cette initiative, nommée « Stop Dirty Data Centres », initiative vise à suspendre temporairement ces constructions afin de donner aux gouvernements le temps d’évaluer leurs retombées environnementales, économiques et sociales.
Pas d'annulation globale, mais un cadre strict

Lequel regrouperait les cadres réglementaires, environnementaux et d'urbanisme. Si des démarches similaires ont déjà été observées aux États-Unis, elles ont conduit à des moratoires, notamment dans l'État de New-York.
Pour appuyer ses revendications, le groupe prévoit des rassemblements les 6 et 7 novembre 2026 dans huit pays : le Royaume-Uni, l’Irlande, la Pologne, le Danemark, la Finlande, l’Espagne, les Pays-Bas et la France. articles.title: ‘Every price rise this generation has been a test' — why PS5, Xbox, and Switch 2 keep getting more expensive

Consoles used to get cheaper with age — so why are PS5, Xbox, and Switch 2 going the other way? Here's what four industry analysts think about the current console landscape
The days of waiting for a console price cut may be over – and the AI boom is only part of the story
Rising console prices are by now a fact of life for gamers, no matter which platform they prefer. The PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X — consoles that are now six years old — cost $150 and $300 more than at launch, respectively; the Nintendo Switch 2, released in 2025, already costs $50 more.
Things haven't always been this way: back in 2013, the PS4 launched for $400, and the PS4 Slim arrived three years later for $300. Price cuts and cheaper versions were traditionally a part — a key part — of the console lifecycle.
In 2026, that pattern is reversed: consoles are getting more expensive rather than cheaper, at a time when everything else is also getting price hikes, and the trend is occurring all over the world, not just in the US and Europe.
To find out why prices keep rising — and whether they'll ever come down — I spoke to four industry analysts: Rhys Elliott at Alinea Analytics, James McWhirter at Omdia, Piers Harding-Rolls at Ampere Analysis, and Mat Piscatella at Circana.

“La innovación requiere asumir riesgos durante mucho tiempo sin resultados visibles”, es la idea que resume su visión sobre el desarrollo empresarial y tecnológico. Su experiencia al frente de Nvidia permite entender por qué esta estrategia fue determinante para que la compañía pasara de competir en el mercado de tarjetas gráficas para videojuegos a convertirse en uno de los actores centrales de la industria de la inteligencia artificial.
La historia de la empresa también muestra que su crecimiento no fue lineal. Durante sus primeros años, Nvidia atravesó dificultades financieras y tuvo que tomar decisiones que podían determinar su continuidad. Las imágenes muestran al empresario con cabello corto y abundante, una apariencia diferente a la que suele exhibir en sus apariciones públicas.

Las fotografías virales fueron modificadas con inteligencia artificial (IA) y parten de escenas que sí corresponden a un viaje de la pareja a Italia en junio de 2023.
La comparación con los registros fotográficos de aquella visita permite identificar el origen de las imágenes y entender cómo una fotografía auténtica puede convertirse en contenido engañoso cuando se altera con herramientas de IA.

Students are too dependent on AI

- Heavy users are more likely to feel schoolwork would become harder without it

New research has likened the relationship between Gen Z and AI use to that of previous generations with smoking cigarettes, characterizing it as widespread adoption, awareness of the negative consequences and a reluctance to give it up.
The study from Fizz found nearly all (96%) college students now use AI, but more than half (56%) would permanently ban the technology.
But although one in two would support banning AI, Fizz shows just how reliant students have become on it, with the proportion of learners believing their work would become much harder rising significantly among frequent AI users.

"The heaviest users are hooked," Fizz declared, noting that 68% of students who use AI multiple times a day believe schoolwork would become harder without AI. This proportion falls to 59% among daily users, 42% among weekly users, 22% among users who use AI just a few times a month, and 9% among those who use it less than once monthly.

C’est une première mondiale selon les autorités chinoises.

L’instrument, lui, dispose d’un système de vision permettant de repérer la cible, de la positionner, de découper et même de récupérer les débris. ExpressVPN has added a new layer of security to its browser extension, and it doesn’t require you to switch the VPN on.
The feature, Web Protection, screens each page as it loads, matching it against continuously refreshed databases of sites known to host malware, scams, or phishing attempts, and stops them before they appear.

One of the more notable aspects of Web Protection is how precisely it blocks. Rather than judging an entire domain, it inspects the full web address.

Two flaws in Barracuda's Email Security Gateway, an email-filtering appliance, can be chained to run commands on it as root, its highest level of access, with no login required.
The company released patches on Monday, and the security firm watchTowr detailed the attack chain on Thursday.
One flaw, CVE-2026-116606, is an authorization bypass. An unauthenticated attacker can use it to restore a crafted configuration backup and change the appliance's global settings.
The other, CVE-2026-111560, is a command injection. It runs commands as root but normally needs an administrator account, and on the Email Security Gateway the bypass gives an attacker that access. Chained, the two let an attacker reach root with no login.
Affected Products and Fixes
The authorization bypass affects only the Email Security Gateway. The command injection reaches five other products, but on those it still needs an administrator account.
Mandiant, which assigned the two CVE records, rates the bypass 9.3 out of 10 and the command injection 8.6. Barracuda has released a patch for each affected product and lists the fixed firmware in its security advisory. The Email Security Gateway is fixed in version 9.4.0.030 and later.
What to Do
The advisory sets out three steps:
- Apply the patch for each affected product, or upgrade to the fixed firmware listed above.
- If you cannot patch at once, limit the appliance's administration interface to trusted internal networks.

articles.title: Hackers Hide Linux Backdoor in Control Web Panel Server to Execute Commands Without Logs
articles.summary:
A backdoor has been found hiding in the web server that runs Control Web Panel (CWP), a free panel for managing Linux hosting servers, researchers at QiAnXin's XLab said this week.
The backdoored web server executes commands that attackers send via web requests, and those requests never appear in its access logs. Installing it takes root access, so the attackers must already control the server.
The researchers, who named the backdoor cwpdoor, captured its installer, a shell script posing as a version update, on June 29. The installer handles only two versions of that web server, cwpsrv 1.15.10 and 1.24.0. The researchers do not yet know how attackers get the root access the installer needs.
On September 30, an archive holding a copy of the backdoor was uploaded to VirusTotal from Brazil. The researchers say this indicates that "real victims already exist in the wild." They give no count of infected servers.
The backdoor is cwpsrv itself, rebuilt with extra code, the researchers found in their technical analysis. It behaves like the normal program until a request arrives with a valid timestamp and signature in custom headers whose names begin with X-Ngx-Integrity. It then runs the command carried in the request.
When the installer replaces the cwpsrv file, it puts the file's dates back to their original values, so checks with ls and stat show it as unchanged. When the researchers checked, the backdoor file had zero detections out of 63 on VirusTotal.

Por eso, buscan evitar que sus hijos queden incorporados a los sistemas oficiales desde el momento en que nacen.
La corriente suele estar asociada con otras prácticas, como los partos domiciliarios, la educación en el hogar y el rechazo a las vacunas. articles.title: The Flood is Coming And The Pipes Were Already Full
articles.summary:
An update on Athena, and some unsolicited predictions on what's coming next
On Saturday, Dario Amodei published We Must Pace the Frontier. I agree with him. Go read it if you haven't. I've spent the summer looking at what these models find, and the gap he describes between what they can do and what the rest of us are ready for is the one I've been staring at since May.
The hardest piece of his plan is the one that asks governments to coordinate. They're in a difficult spot: regulate too little and a US company accidentally builds the weapon, regulate too much and it gets built somewhere else, and open source isn't governable either way. Where governments can act is on consumption: not what the models can do, but what happens to what they find. Who gets a vulnerability first, how fast a fix reaches the people running the code, whether the operators who can't move on an attacker's timeline get a head start. That's what Gold Eagle is.
It matters because of where the risk actually lands. The danger in Dario's essay isn't a model in a lab. It's a model pointed at the power grid, the water system, the hospital network, all of it running on decades of software with the same exploitable design. The frontier is where the capability comes from. Consumption is where it does damage, and that's the end you can still defend.

articles.title: Malicious Browser Extensions Could Use Claude Dispatch to Run Code on Users' Computers
articles.summary:
A browser extension that can run scripts on claude.ai could make Claude Desktop run code on a person's computer, researchers at Forever Security, an endpoint security company, showed in a test.
The attack needs Dispatch, a Claude feature that lets people send tasks from their phone to Claude Desktop. The flaw that makes this possible can still be exploited, the researchers said earlier this week.
Claude Desktop is an AI agent that can run commands on the computer where it is installed. The researchers found that Dispatch also accepted an ordinary signed-in session on claude.ai, the Claude website, even though the site showed no link to it. That let an extension running on the site send Claude Desktop instructions as if the user had sent them.
The researchers say Anthropic, the company that makes Claude, told them on October 13 that Dispatch would be retired, with the end of October as the target. The Dispatch help page, last updated late last week, does not mention a retirement.
It says Dispatch is closed to new users and that people who already use it on some Pro, Max, and Ultra plans "can keep using it for now."
How the Attack Worked
The attack needs two things, according to a technical write-up by Forever Security researcher Gal Weizman: an extension that can run scripts on claude.ai, and a person signed in to both claude.ai and Claude Desktop with Dispatch turned on.

A fix for CVE-2026-83844, a remote code execution flaw in Windows Paint, is now in the Microsoft Store. Paint gets this fix only through a Store update, not through Windows updates.
The fixed build, 11.2609.401.0, was the newest Paint build in all ten countries The Hacker News checked today.
The flaw is an out-of-bounds read that could let an attacker run code over a network. Microsoft rates it as Important, with a CVSS score of 8.1, and says that a successful attack requires a deep understanding of the target system. The flaw was not known to be exploited or publicly disclosed when the company published it on October 13.
Brian Vitko of RFF, a device-management software maker, checked which Paint builds the Store offered in six countries earlier this week. He found that the newest in each was 11.2605.81.0, a build without the fix.
His test virtual machine has since moved to the fixed build on its own, through Store auto-update. That is one machine, and how quickly other PCs will get the build is not yet clear.
Which Build Counts as Fixed
Microsoft's security advisory names 11.2609.401.0 as the fixed build. The CVE record for the flaw, which the company also publishes, still lists Paint as affected only below 11.2605.91.0. Its NVD entry shows the same range.
So a scanner that reads the CVE record would treat any build from 11.2605.91.0 up as fixed. A copy at 11.2609.401.0 or later passes under both numbers.

Threat actors are attempting to exploit a recently disclosed security flaw impacting OpenSSH that can enable sign-ins to accounts that have no password set, according to Previdian.
The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-123158 (CVSS score: 8.1) and codenamed SSHole (or *sshole), impacts Linux systems that run OpenSSH on the musl C library with Pluggable Authentication Modules (PAM) disabled, including Alpine Linux's default OpenSSH server configuration.
An unauthenticated attacker can supply an oversized password to access accounts that are deliberately configured without usable passwords, without having to steal credentials or SSH keys. The issue, discovered by security researcher Ozgun Kultekin, has been addressed in OpenSSH 10.6p2.
The underlying issue dates back to a patch introduced in 2016 to fix a username enumeration vulnerability tracked as CVE-2016-6210. Under specific conditions, the password-handling behavior in OpenSSH mistakenly interprets a failed password-hashing operation as successful authentication by producing the same value ("*") used to indicate that an account with password disabled at the system level.
An attacker can trigger the vulnerability to authenticate to certain password-disabled accounts using an arbitrary password between 257 and 1,024 bytes long, causing the hash attempt to fail and returning an asterisk. The sshd daemon then compares with the asterisk stored in the account's password field, leading to a successful login.

Some WordPress sites can still be attacked while they install the fix for an actively exploited flaw, according to Umut Bayram, the Picus Security researcher who found it.
The update that installs the fix still unpacks its files using the site's old, unpatched code, so an attacker who strikes at the right moment can run code on the server. The researcher advises blocking web access to the site's wp-content/upgrade folder before updating.
The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-119977, affects WordPress 4.7 through 7.1.3. During a core update that uses a complete package, WordPress unpacks a copy of the new version into a temporary folder inside wp-content/upgrade. That copy includes the WordPress installer, and the web server can usually reach it.
An attacker with no account who can determine the folder's name and access the installer before WordPress deletes the copy can end up running code on the server. The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) added the flaw to its catalog of known exploited vulnerabilities earlier this week.
WordPress released the fix last week in version 7.1.4 and in matching updates for older branches back to 4.7, all listed in its security advisory.
The fix gives the temporary folder a random name. But the update that installs the fix unpacks its files using the old code already on the site, as WordPress's updater code shows. On sites running 5.9 or later, that old code names the folder after the downloaded file, so the name can be predic…

articles.title: Une marche pour arrêter la course l’IA va traverser Paris, avec un parcours ô combien symbolique
articles.summary:
À Paris, une marche pour la sécurité de l'IA ira de l'ambassade des États-Unis à celle de Chine, le 14 novembre. À l'appel de Pause IA, les manifestants exigent un traité international pour arrêter la course effrénée à l'intelligence artificielle.
Il y a les manifestations contre la vie chère en ce moment en France, mais certains n'oublient pas l'essor de l'intelligence artificielle et ses potentielles conséquences sur notre société au sens large. Une marche pour la sécurité de l'IA traversera ainsi Paris le samedi 14 novembre, à l'appel de l'association Pause IA, qui l'organise avec Stop The AI Race. Son tracé, de l'ambassade des États-Unis à celle de Chine, est tout trouvé puisque quatre jours plus tard, Donald Trump et Xi Jinping se rencontreront au sommet de l'APEC, à Shenzhen. Les marcheurs devraient réclamer un traité sur l'IA que la diplomatie mondiale, pour l'instant, se contente d'effleurer.
Ils veulent « reprendre le contrôle » de l’IA et marcheront dans Paris le 14 novembre
Pour le 14 novembre, le rendez-vous est donné à 11 heures près de l'ambassade des États-Unis, place de la Concorde. Le cortège rejoindra ensuite l'ambassade de Chine, avenue George V, pour un rassemblement prévu à midi, avant de filer vers le Trocadéro. Le final se jouera à 12h40 face au Parvis des Droits de l'Homme, avec la tour Eiffel en toile de fond. Deux heures de marche, et deux superpuissances interpellées.

articles.title: Tesla : fin de partie pour le Cybertruck !
articles.summary:
C'était un modèle de véhicule électrique qui devait faire entrer Tesla dans le futur. Mais le Cybertruck n'aura finalement pas tenu ses promesses, et sa production va s'achever.
Ça commençait à sentir mauvais pour les Cybertruck ces dernières semaines. Le pick-up cyberpunk de Tesla, qui avait été teasé durant des années avant de faire son arrivée à la fin 2023, étaient devenu indisponible déjà pour les clients australiens et néo-zélandais. Une décision prise alors que des commandes avaient été prises il y a sept ans. Un écueil qui annonçait une décision plus radicale.
Elon Musk annonce officiellement la fin du Cybertruck pour 2027
Le Cybertruck avait été un véritable événement à sa sortie. Mais le pick-up monstrueux de Tesla sort par la petite porte. Elon Musk vient ainsi d'annoncer dans un simple message posté sur X que sa production allait s'arrêter l'an prochain.
« Tesla va réduire progressivement la production du Cybertruck à la Gigafactory du Texas vers le milieu de l'année prochaine, afin de faire de la place pour une production accrue du Cybercab » a-t-il ainsi expliqué.
Un échec industriel qui n'aura tenu que quelques années
Avec une sortie fin 2023, ce Cybertruck n'aura ainsi pas même tenu cinq ans. Un désastre commercial pour un modèle sur lequel Elon Musk comptait énormément, et qu'il voyait rapidement se vendre à hauteur de 250 000 unités par an. articles.title: Even Microsoft Paint is being targeted by cyberattackers — update now or face the consequences
articles.summary:
Even Microsoft Paint is being targeted by cyberattackers — update now or face the consequences
There's a way to execute malicious code remotely through Paint
- Microsoft fixes high-severity Paint vulnerability that could allow remote code execution through crafted image files
- Security updates are delivered through the Microsoft Store, leaving some users temporarily stuck on vulnerable versions
- Users should verify their Paint version and install the latest update as soon as it becomes available
Microsoft has addressed a high-severity vulnerability in Paint that allowed threat actors to run malicious code remotely. However, fixing the issue doesn’t seem to be a straightforward process for users, as the patched version, surprisingly, remains unavailable for download for some people.
Tracked as CVE-2026-83844 and with a severity score of 8.1/10 (high), this bug was described by the National Vulnerability Database (NVD) as an “out-of-bounds read in Windows Paint [that] allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.”
In theory, a threat actor could create a special image that, if opened via paint, can trigger the flaw and execute malicious code on an affected system.
How to patch Paint

articles.title: Une faille permettait d’accéder à certains serveurs Alpine Linux sans connaître le mot de passe
articles.summary:
Avec un mot de passe de plus de 256 caractères, tapé au hasard, un pirate pouvait ouvrir une session SSH sur certains serveurs Alpine Linux dès sa première tentative, sur un compte dépourvu de mot de passe. Les développeurs d’OpenSSH et d’Alpine ont publié un correctif en urgence.
Alpine Linux est une distribution très légère, appréciée pour faire tourner des conteneurs Docker et de petits serveurs. Sur certaines machines équipées de cette distribution, il suffisait à un attaquant de joindre le port SSH pour se connecter sans connaître le moindre mot de passe. Le chercheur Özgün Kültekin a signalé la faille au projet OpenSSH, dont l’équipe l’a classée critique. Personne n’a signalé d’attaque à ce jour. Mais d’après l’avis de sécurité d’Alpine, l’intrus réussit sa connexion à chaque essai, avec une seule tentative.
Un mot de passe de plus de 256 caractères pour ouvrir les comptes sans mot de passe
La faille remonte à 2016. Pour corriger une autre vulnérabilité, CVE-2016-6210, les développeurs d’OpenSSH ont alors modifié la vérification des mots de passe sur les serveurs configurés sans PAM, les modules chargés d’ordinaire de l’authentification sous Linux. Sans eux, le mot de passe tapé est haché avec la fonction crypt(), puis comparé à l’empreinte enregistrée sur la machine. Ce calcul a besoin d’un sel, une donnée aléatoire mélangée au mot de passe. articles.title: Windows 11 27H2 rumored to be a 'full OS swap' worthy of being called Windows 12 — but the name won't matter if Microsoft has a 24H2-like nightmare
articles.summary:
We're not getting Windows 12 next year, but Windows 11 27H2 is rumored to be a huge change — and it's an update Microsoft just can't afford to mess up
I hope Microsoft isn't sailing straight towards a 24H2-shaped iceberg
- Windows 11 27H2 is underway and will be a "full OS swap" according to anonymous sources
- Microsoft will stop short of launching it as Windows 12 (but the report doesn't fully rule that idea out)
- Testing will begin a lot earlier with 27H2 next year, compared to the typical June timeframe when Microsoft kicked off previews with 26H2 and 25H2
The next major version of Windows 11 arriving next year will pack some big changes, and what will theoretically be the 27H2 update is set to be very different from the last couple of annual updates for Microsoft's OS, which have been very minor affairs.
The Verge reports that the usual anonymous sources claim that Microsoft is already preparing Windows 11 27H2, and it will be a "full OS swap" with significant upgrades in the same vein as the last major update for the operating system, which debuted in 2024 (and ushered in a new underlying platform for Windows 11).
We're told that there will be a "big focus on quality" with 27H2, and that despite what'll evidently be some sizeable changes, it won't be released as Windows 12.
